scenes.narration: One egg is hiding a HUGE prize! Which one is it?
Is it the blue egg, the yellow egg, or the red egg? Choose fast!
Lock in your answer! Three… two… one!
The blue egg… opens up and it's full of stinky socks! Ewww!
The yellow egg… it's a rubber chicken! Not quite the prize!
The RED egg is the winner! Open it up and… it's a golden trophy! Amazing!
Did you pick red? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
